tech_stack.architecture: Monolithic single-server (Windows EC2 + IIS 7 + SQL Server 2005)

findings.title: No Programmatic API — HTML Pages Only
findings.description: The application exposes only HTML-rendered ColdFusion pages (index.cfm, download.cfm) served by IIS. There is no REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface. Integration requires UI automation or direct database access.
findings.gap: No programmatic API exists. The only integration surface is HTML pages rendered by ColdFusion 8.
findings.recommendation: Build a REST API with JSON responses exposing document search and download functionality.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Expose document search and download as REST API with JSON responses
blocker_remediation.target_state: Documented REST API separate from HTML UI layer

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or machine-readable specification found in the repository.
findings.gap: Agent tool generation requires manual reverse-engineering of ColdFusion page behavior.
findings.recommendation: Create OpenAPI 3.x specification for any new API surface using annotation-driven generation.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: No structured error responses. ColdFusion throws raw exceptions or displays HTML error pages with no error codes or machine-readable bodies.
findings.gap: Agents cannot distinguish retriable from terminal errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured JSON error responses with error code, message, and retryable flag in new API layer.

findings.title: No Idempotency Controls on Write Operations
findings.description: Write operations (file uploads) have no idempotency keys, no unique constraints on business keys, and no deduplication logic.
findings.gap: Agent retries or duplicate calls would create duplicate records/files.
findings.recommendation: Implement idempotency key support for all write operations.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency controls exist
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system performs write operations (document uploads) with no idempotency mechanism. Agent retries at machine speed would create duplicates.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add idempotency key support to upload operations
blocker_remediation.target_state: All write endpoints accept idempotency key; duplicate submissions return original result

findings.title: HTML-Only Response Format
findings.description: All responses are rendered as HTML by ColdFusion templates. No structured data format (JSON, XML) is returned.
findings.gap: LLMs cannot directly parse HTML table responses. Agent integration requires HTML parsing or translation layer.
findings.recommendation: Use JSON as default format in new API layer.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission capability exists. No webhooks, SNS, EventBridge, SQS, or Kafka integration.
findings.gap: Agents must poll for state changes. No proactive notification of document lifecycle events.
findings.recommendation: Implement EventBridge events for document lifecycle changes when building new architecture.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limits documented and no rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Remaining, Retry-After) returned.
findings.gap: Agents have no self-throttling signals.
findings.recommendation: Configure API Gateway usage plans with rate limit headers when deploying new API.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: The application supports only session-based human authentication. No OAuth2 client credentials, API key authentication, mTLS, or service accounts exist.
findings.gap: Agents cannot authenticate without human credentials.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 client credentials or API key authentication with principal attribution.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Deploy API Gateway with Cognito/OAuth2 or implement API key authentication
blocker_remediation.target_state: Machine identity with principal attribution in audit logs

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: Binary authenticated/unauthenticated authorization only. All authenticated users have identical, unrestricted access.
findings.gap: Cannot grant agent read-only access to specific resources without granting full access.
findings.recommendation: Implement RBAC with minimum viewer/editor/admin roles enforced at query level.

compensating_controls: Deploy API Gateway with IAM-based per-method authorization
Implement role-based access at the application level

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization exists. The only security check is session existence with no distinction between read and write permissions.
findings.gap: Cannot restrict an agent to read-only operations within the same resource type.
findings.recommendation: Add per-action permission checks (canRead, canWrite, canDelete) enforced before operations.

compensating_controls: Enforce action-level authorization at API Gateway (GET allowed, POST/DELETE blocked per API key)
Implement middleware permission checks

findings.title: No Identity Propagation or Delegation
findings.description: No identity propagation mechanism (JWT, OAuth2 on-behalf-of, token exchange). System cannot distinguish agent-as-self vs agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.gap: Cannot implement delegated access patterns or bound agent permissions by user permissions.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2/JWT-based identity propagation supporting service-to-service and on-behalf-of flows.

compensating_controls: Require agents to pass user context header validated against session store
Implement OAuth2 token exchange at API Gateway

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials — No Secrets Management
findings.description: Credentials managed in ColdFusion Administrator with known password 'cfadmin'. No secrets management system, no rotation.
findings.gap: Static credentials vulnerable to leakage via prompt injection or insider threat.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation. Remove all hardcoded passwords.

compensating_controls: Rotate CF Admin password and restrict network access immediately
Move datasource credentials to Secrets Manager

findings.title: No Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging of any kind exists. No CloudTrail, no application-level audit trail, no immutable log storage.
findings.gap: Cannot determine who accessed or modified documents. Zero accountability trail.
findings.recommendation: Enable CloudTrail and implement application audit logging with immutable storage (S3 Object Lock).

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging exists
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agent scope requires immutable audit trails for compliance. Zero logging means no forensics for agent actions.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Enable CloudTrail; implement application-level audit logging
blocker_remediation.target_state: Immutable audit log recording every operation with principal attribution

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Mechanism
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend or revoke individual identities. Session-based auth with no revocation beyond timeout.
findings.gap: Cannot isolate misbehaving agent without shutting down entire application.
findings.recommendation: Implement API key or OAuth2 client credential system with immediate revocation capability.

compensating_controls: Implement API Gateway with revocable API keys
Add deny-list table that blocks specific principals

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback Logic
findings.description: No compensation or rollback logic exists. No saga patterns, undo endpoints, or compensating transactions. Writes commit immediately with no reversal mechanism.
findings.gap: Failed multi-step operations leave partial state with no recovery path.
findings.recommendation: Implement two-phase commit pattern with compensation logic for write operations.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no compensation/rollback exists
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents executing multi-step workflows with no rollback leave data in inconsistent state on failure.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement two-phase upload: staging → pending → active with cleanup on failure
blocker_remediation.target_state: All write operations support compensation or rollback

findings.title: State Not Machine-Readable
findings.description: Document state is queryable via SQL (index.cfm search) but rendered only as HTML — not accessible in structured format for agent consumption.
findings.gap: State is only accessible via HTML rendering, not machine-readable API.
findings.recommendation: Expose document state via JSON API with query, filter, and pagination.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic locking, version fields, ETags, or conditional writes exist. Concurrent agent instances could corrupt data through race conditions.
findings.gap: Multiple agents writing simultaneously could overwrite each other or create duplicates.
findings.recommendation: Add version fields and implement optimistic locking on write operations.

compensating_controls: Add version columns with optimistic locking
Serialize agent access through queue-based pattern

findings.title: No Rate Limiting at Any Layer
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. No API Gateway, WAF, or application-level throttling. Application runs directly on IIS with no protection.
findings.gap: Runaway agent loops could overwhelm the application and database with unlimited requests.
findings.recommendation: Deploy AWS WAF with rate-based rules or API Gateway with throttling.

compensating_controls: Deploy WAF with rate-based rules
Deploy API Gateway with usage plans and throttling

findings.title: No Blast Radius or Transaction Limits
findings.description: No transaction limits or per-caller caps. SQL injection vulnerability enables unbounded data operations. No bulk operation size caps.
findings.gap: Agent errors could result in mass deletion or modification with no safeguards.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-caller transaction limits for all write operations.

compensating_controls: Implement per-session operation limits
Add bulk operation size caps in new API layer

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft or pending state exists. All operations are immediately committed with no reviewable intermediate state.
findings.gap: Agent cannot propose changes for human review before committing.
findings.recommendation: Implement PENDING/DRAFT status for document uploads requiring human approval.

compensating_controls: Add status column with PENDING/APPROVED/REJECTED states
Implement review queue for agent-submitted documents

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval gates or configurable operation-level flags. All operations execute immediately without human-in-the-loop option.
findings.gap: Cannot require human approval for high-risk agent operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval gates for destructive operations in new API layer.

compensating_controls: Build approval workflow using status-based state machines
Use Step Functions with human approval tasks

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No sandbox or staging environment. Single production EC2 instance with no environment separation.
findings.gap: No safe environment to test agent behavior before production.
findings.recommendation: Create containerized local environment and staging with production-equivalent data shape.

findings.title: No Access Control Differentiation for Documents
findings.description: System stores documents accessible to all authenticated users without access differentiation. No role-based or category-based access controls. Stage A: Yes (user-specific data). B1: CLEAR (metadata fields not sensitive). B2: FIRES (no access differentiation). B3: Absent.
findings.gap: Single permission level grants access to all documents regardless of sensitivity classification.
findings.recommendation: Implement document sensitivity classification with role-based access enforcement.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to RISK-SAFETY: B1 CLEAR (no sensitive fields leaked in metadata), B2 FIRES (no access differentiation), B3 absent (INFO)
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: DATA-Q1 B2 fired because all authenticated users access all documents without differentiation — no mechanism exists to scope agent access to non-sensitive document categories.

b1.reasoning: API responses show document metadata (title, category, uploaded_by, date) — no sensitive fields leaked

b2.reasoning: No access control differentiation — single permission grants access to all documents

compensating_controls: Implement document classification labels (public, internal, confidential)
Add category-based access controls per role

findings.title: Data Residency — No Regulated Data Identified
findings.description: Corporate policy documents on single EC2 instance. No evidence of GDPR/HIPAA/LGPD regulated data requiring residency controls.
findings.gap: No data classification exists to confirm absence of residency requirements.
findings.recommendation: Conduct data classification exercise to confirm no documents are subject to residency requirements.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to INFO: No regulated data identified in repository evidence
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system stores corporate policy documents and forms. No evidence of PII, PHI, financial instruments, or data subject to jurisdictional residency requirements.

findings.title: No Pagination — Unbounded Result Sets
findings.description: Basic title search exists but no pagination, result limits, sorting options, or field selection. All matching documents returned in unbounded result set.
findings.gap: Agent queries return unbounded results, exhausting LLM context windows.
findings.recommendation: Implement cursor-based pagination with configurable result size limits.

findings.title: SQL Injection — Zero Input Validation
findings.description: Zero input validation. SQL queries use string concatenation (WHERE title LIKE '%#url.q#%' and WHERE doc_id = #url.id#) — directly vulnerable to SQL injection.
findings.gap: System accepts arbitrary input without validation, enabling SQL injection attacks.
findings.recommendation: Replace string-concatenated SQL with cfqueryparam parameterized queries immediately. Add input validation.

findings.title: Incomplete Temporal Metadata
findings.description: Only uploaded_on field exists, displayed without timezone. No updated_at, no Cache-Control headers, no freshness signaling.
findings.gap: Incomplete temporal metadata without modification tracking or freshness indicators.
findings.recommendation: Add UTC timestamps with updated_at and expose freshness metadata in API responses.

findings.title: No PII Redaction in Logs
findings.description: No PII redaction exists. User names rendered in responses (session.fullname). Search queries (url.q) visible in IIS access logs.
findings.gap: User data and search queries logged without PII protection.
findings.recommendation: Implement PII masking in application logs and sanitize IIS request logging.

compensating_controls: Implement log sanitization middleware
Configure IIS to exclude query strings from access logs

findings.title: No Data Quality Metrics
findings.description: No data quality metrics, profiling, or monitoring exist for the document repository.
findings.gap: Cannot assess data completeness or reliability.
findings.recommendation: Implement basic data quality monitoring (document count trends, completeness).

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning, migration files, API contracts, changelog, or breaking change detection.
findings.gap: Schema and API changes undetectable by agent consumers. Tool bindings break silently.
findings.recommendation: Implement database migration tooling and API versioning for new API surface.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog, metadata layer, or semantic descriptions of document data.
findings.gap: No self-service discovery for tool builders.
findings.recommendation: Document database schema and consider AWS Glue Data Catalog.

findings.title: No Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No distributed tracing, structured logging, correlation IDs, or trace ID propagation. Zero observability instrumentation.
findings.gap: Agent-initiated requests cannot be traced or correlated for debugging.
findings.recommendation: Implement OpenTelemetry with trace ID propagation and JSON structured logging.

findings.title: No Alerting Configuration
findings.description: No alerting configured. No CloudWatch alarms, anomaly detection, or incident management integration.
findings.gap: System degradation undetectable until users report failures.
findings.recommendation: Deploy CloudWatch alarms for error rates, latency, and resource utilization.

findings.title: No Business Outcome Metrics
findings.description: No business outcome metrics published. No custom CloudWatch metrics or KPI dashboards.
findings.gap: Cannot measure agent interaction effectiveness.
findings.recommendation: Implement custom metrics for document access patterns and search effectiveness.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK). Infrastructure manually provisioned. Deployment via manual file copy over network share.
findings.gap: No governance, no peer review of infrastructure changes, no drift detection.
findings.recommendation: Define infrastructure as CloudFormation/Terraform with PR-based review.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline. No GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or CodeBuild. Manual file copy deployment.
findings.gap: No automated testing or contract validation before production deployment.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD with automated testing and API contract validation.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No rollback capability. Deployment is manual file copy with no versioning, blue/green, canary, or feature flags.
findings.gap: Broken deployments cannot be quickly reversed.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated deployment with rollback (CodeDeploy, ECS blue/green).

findings.title: Zero Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests of any kind. No API tests, unit tests, integration tests, or contract tests.
findings.gap: API behavior changes undetectable before affecting agent consumers.
findings.recommendation: Implement API test suites covering input validation, output format, errors, and edge cases.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest. SQL Server 2005 (no TDE). Files stored on unencrypted local disk. No KMS, no EBS encryption.
findings.gap: All data stored unencrypted. Disk breach exposes everything.
findings.recommendation: Enable EBS encryption. Migrate to RDS with KMS and S3 with SSE-KMS.

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no evidence of operations >30s or long-running workflows

evaluations.title: Circuit Breakers and Resilience
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no evidence of external dependency calls

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no P0 priority specified and no evidence of critical path

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: Database field names are human-readable and semantically meaningful (doc_id, title, category, uploaded_by, uploaded_on, filename). No legacy codes requiring data dictionary.

items.summary: Resolve all BLOCKERs (API surface, machine identity, audit logging, rollback) and critical RISK-SAFETY findings (permissions, rate limiting, PII). This phase establishes the minimum viable secure integration surface.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY and RISK-QUALITY findings: identity propagation, observability, schema versioning, staging environments, and engineering maturity.
Polish the integration surface: API specification, structured errors, business metrics, data quality monitoring, and comprehensive test coverage.

recommended_actions.action: Build REST API layer with JSON responses
recommended_actions.rationale: The most fundamental blocker — without a programmatic API, no agent integration is possible. All other remediations build on this.
Machine identity is required for any agent to authenticate. Scoped permissions and suspension capability depend on this.

recommended_actions.action: Implement immutable audit logging (CloudTrail + application logs)
recommended_actions.rationale: Compliance requirement for write-enabled agents. Cannot prove what agents did without audit trail.

recommended_actions.action: Migrate credentials to AWS Secrets Manager
recommended_actions.rationale: Known hardcoded password ('cfadmin') is an immediate security vulnerability regardless of agent integration.
Protects against agent traffic storms. Can be deployed independently of other changes.
Critical security vulnerability independent of agent readiness. Enables unbounded data modification.
